overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Avila 1-2 Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a compact, luxurious retreat for enhancing your wellness routine at home. Designed with 7 dynamic Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, it provides soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna is perfect for indoor spaces like basements or master baths. Enjoy added features like Bluetooth connectivity and an interior chromotherapy lighting system for a truly personalized, spa-like experience.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas are constructed of environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood planks. Our saunas feature energy efficient Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that help relax and rejuvenate the body. Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can also be added to a fitness room.

Wood Type: Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction
Glass: Clear Tempered glass door and with side Window
Interior Lighting: Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Feature
Control Panels: Interior LED control panels
